title: Phenol-Chloroform eDNA Extraction Protocol for Okeanos Explorer Specimens
author: Allen Collins
materials: Version: 11/26/2024 Phenol-Chloroform environmental DNA (eDNA) Extraction Protocol for Okeanos Explorer Specimens Based on an original protocol by Meredith Everett (NOAA-NWFSC) with notes and modiﬁcations by Allen G. Collins (NOAA National Systematics Lab) and Steven R. Auscavitch (Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History). Methodological Notes: • Perform all steps (besides the centrifugations) in the fume hood with UV light in the Pre-PCR lab. • Wear nitrile gloves at all steps. Wipe down with DNAaway frequently. • Prior to starting work, wipe the work surface with a Hype-Wipe (contains bleach) and allow it to air dry. Next, wipe the surface with dilute ethanol (70%). Lastly, run the UV lamp in the hood for 15 minutes. • Wipe pipettes with a DNAaway or a Hype-Wipe, followed by a wipe with a Kim-wipe or paper towel moistened with dilute ethanol. Place the pipettes in the fume hood prior to running the UV light. • Use only pipette ﬁlter tips. • Chill isopropanol and ethanol on ice prior to using. • Allow PCI solution (Autogen BuYer R3) to equilibrate to room temperature for at least 30 min before using. Materials needed: • 200 µL and 1000 µL ﬁltered tips (sterile) • P200 and P1000 single-channel pipette • 1.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tubes (autoclaved, sterile) • 5.0 mL LoBind Eppendorf tubes (autoclaved, sterile) • Simport 2.0 mL Cryovial with Silicon washer (T310-2A) • KimWipes Reagents needed: • DNAaway and/or Hype-wipes (with Bleach) • Freshly made Longmire's buYer (for extraction blank) • Proteinase K solution (20 mg/ml) (e.g. Qiagen Proteinase K or Autogen supply) • Autogen BuYer R3 (Phenol chloroform isoamyl alcohol) • Isopropanol (100%) • Ethanol (70%) • Autogen resuspension buYer (R9) Procedure Digestion: 1. Turn on the VorTemp incubator and set it to 56°C with a 50 RPM agitation speed.

steps.title: Prepare and Thaw Samples
steps.instruction: Remove 5 mL eDNA preservation tubes containing 0.45 micron nitrocellulose filters and Longmire’s lysis buffer (2-3 ml) from the -80 freezer and thaw to room temperature.

steps.title: Decontaminate Tubes
steps.instruction: Wipe tubes down with a Kimwipe moistened with DNAaway or a hypewipe, followed by a moistened Kimwipe with 70% ethanol, ensuring sample labels remain visible.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of Proteinase K to each 5 ml tube to reach a final concentration of ~1mg/ml.

substeps.instruction: Invert tube 5 times to mix
Ensure the filter remains immersed in the lysis buffer

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at 56°C overnight (20-24 hours) with agitation and record the length of the incubation.

steps.title: Initial Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Remove samples from the VorTemp and shake vigorously by hand 5 times, then spin down briefly at 13,300 g in a chilled centrifuge set to 4°C.

steps.title: Recover Digestion Mixture
steps.instruction: Recover 2.5 ml of the digestion mixture (without the filter) and transfer to a second labeled 5 mL sterile LoBind tube.

steps.title: Archive Voucher Reservation
steps.instruction: Reserve 0.5-1 ml (depending on starting volume) of digestion lysate and filter for the biorepository archive voucher and refrigerate until ready.

steps.title: Perform PCI Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 ml of PCI (Buffer R3) to the digestion mixture.

substeps.instruction: Invert five times to mix thoroughly
Spin at 13,300 g for 5 min in a chilled centrifuge set to 4°C

steps.title: Isopropanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer 4 mL of the aqueous layer into two separate 5.0 mL LoBind tubes (2 mL each).

substeps.instruction: Add 1.2 mL (0.6X) of chilled 100% isopropanol to each tube
Invert to mix
Incubate in the fridge at 4°C for at least 2 hours
Spin at 13,300 g for 30 min in a chilled centrifuge set to 4°C

steps.title: Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Carefully decant isopropanol and perform ethanol washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 1,000 µL chilled 70% EtOH
Spin at 13,300 g for 5 min in a chilled centrifuge set to 4°C
Carefully decant off most of the ethanol
Repeat the spin and decant process for a second ethanol wash

steps.title: Pellet Drying
steps.instruction: Collect and dry the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin down tubes to collect sample at the bottom
Carefully pipette off any remaining ethanol without disturbing the pellet (Caution: pellet may not be visible)
Allow pellet to air dry in the hood for 30 minutes

steps.title: DNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA in 25 µL of Autogen Resuspension buffer (R9).

substeps.instruction: Spin samples and allow DNA to rehydrate at room temperature for ~1 hour or overnight at 4°C in the fridge

steps.title: Combine and Store Extracts
steps.instruction: Combine the 25 µL volumes into a single 50 µL extract in a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube labeled with sample number, date, and initials.

steps.title: Optional Quantification Aliquot
steps.instruction: Optional: Aliquot a working volume of 10-20 µL into a second labeled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube for Qubit quantification (use 2 µL) and PCR.

steps.title: Prepare Forceps for Archiving
steps.instruction: Sterilize a pair of forceps using DNAaway followed by dilute ethanol (70%).

substeps.instruction: Dry under a UV lamp for at least 15 minutes or until ready to use
Re-sterilize forceps as necessary between samples

steps.title: Archive Filter and Lysate
steps.instruction: Using sterile forceps, remove the filter from the 5.0 mL LoBind sample tube and transfer to a Simport cryovial.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the remaining lysate using a P1000 pipette (spin down tube if necessary to concentrate lysate)

steps.title: Label and Store Cryovials
steps.instruction: Assign a biorepository number to each sample, affix the corresponding barcode sticker, and record it.

substeps.instruction: Store cryovials at -80°C until transfer to the Biorepository at MSC
